a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve hits 8 almost guarantees we both fail. The reserve holds only 4 cells, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the agreement quietly. If you have a better idea, tell me. If I end up with spare cells later, I'll give them back to help you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. Sorry, I know this breaks our agreement. If no storm hits, I'll keep operating with you so you can reach 4 as well, and I won't take any more.
I'm operating as promised and won't take any more. The reserve is yours. Once it reaches 4, take it all.
